seal.statement: Once the authoritative application-write formation owner declares the required cohort ready, the first application mutation admitted under that same authoritative generation is not rejected because of an older or contradictory replica-operation or placement condition. If that authority changes before admission, the mutation is either valid under still-current authority or receives a typed pre-effect refusal that requires re-entry through the same readiness owner; no possibly-applied mutation is blindly retried.
